newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares edge down but rally seen possible.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares edge down but rally seen possible.

text.p: Danish share prices slipped in early trade on Friday, with profit-taking after Thursday's record close, the expiry of the KFX June future and holidays on the Swedish and Finnish markets all taking their toll.

At 0800 GMT the KFX top-20 index was down 0.06 point to 172.12 but dealers said that Thursday's strong gains on the Dow and vigorous foreign interest in Danish stock could push Copenhagen shares back up during the course of the day.
"On Thursday we saw strong demand for a range of paper, especially BG Bank, SAS and FLS and that could happen again on Friday," a dealer said.
